profile.headline: Data Engineer at Pfizer
profile.summary:
City dweller who loves to travel, partake in outdoor activities, and find new adventures along the way. My goal is to build efficient data solutions that drive insights and innovation. I am adept at using data technologies such as Python, Snowflake, Tableau, and more.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built a centralized site-owner management platform, replacing Excel-based tracking.
Led end-to-end technical development of annualreview.pfizer.com, streamlining engineering processes and reducing release timeline from 4 months to 1 month.
Led SDLC for Pfizer.com feature requests, improving release times by average of two weeks.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated and consolidated Snowflake Task Graphs to Airflow DAGs to create a centralized ETL process.
Utilized Snowflake metadata to develop an SQL-based view that facilitates tracking of table updates.
Improved database eﬃciency by 35% by addressing duplicate tables, processes, and tasks.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site

positions.title: Teaching Assistant: Introduction to Operating Systems
positions.description:
Trusted with grading homework assignments of 20 students on a biweekly basis.
Assisted students with course questions by hosting weekly office hours and replying to questions on Piazza.

positions.title: I.T. Assistant
positions.description:
Deliver timely and efficient technical assistance concerning desktops, laptops, printers, and mobile devices.
Provide concise, interactive data visualizations of time logs for upper management.
Reduced out of office time during division’s latest move by setting up workstations in two days.
Streamlined Senior VP’s office filing system by digitizing documents allowing for simultaneous use between users
Increased server storage for division by consolidating two servers into one.
